3525-4474-8230.easyPrerequisites: Seedship Agrarian doesn't have summoning sickness.
3525-4474-8230.description:
Activate Seedship Agrarian by tapping it, adding {U}.
Seedship Agrarian triggers, creating a Lander token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Seedship Agrarian.
Repeat.

1939-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
1939-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

2811-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
2811-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2113-3249-4556--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-3249-4556--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

561-7675-7676.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Maestros Theater.
561-7675-7676.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Maestros Theater.
When Maestros Theater enters, it and Tifa trigger.
Resolve the Tifa trigger, doubling its power until end of turn.
Resolve the Maestros Theater trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for an applicable land and put it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5205-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
5205-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

7916-7924-8090.description:
Cast Armed with Proof by paying {2}{W}.
When Armed with Proof enters, it triggers, creating two Clue tokens.
When the Clues enter as Equipment due to Armed with Proof, their living weapon abilities given by them to Ekthi each trigger.
Resolve the first living weapon trigger, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
When the Clue enters as an Equipment, its living weapon ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Repeat step 5.

2557-3129-4772-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3532-5078-6792-7693.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
3532-5078-6792-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

1368-1563-4927-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-4927-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2092-2757-4448-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Dimir House Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Dimir House Guard, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Dimir House Guard by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

643-3015-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Rhonas.
When God-Eternal Rhonas dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Rhonas's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Rhonas.
As God-Eternal Rhonas is a Lhurgoyf due to Maskwood Nexus, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Rhonas from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When God-Eternal Rhonas enters, it triggers, doubling the power of other creatures you control until end of turn.
Repeat.

5147-5508--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the persist creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat

2073-6808-7396.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 13 or higher.
You control a creature with power 2 or greater.
2073-6808-7396.description:
Activate The Last Ride's crew ability by tapping a creature with power 2 or greater, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
The Last Ride dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1869-3839-5231.description:
Cast Changeling Hero by paying {4}{W}.
Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Changeling Hero with haste.
The token Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Changeling Hero.
The nontoken Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Changeling Hero trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least one mana.
The Changeling Hero token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Hero from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-6259-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

509-1267-5548-5776.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-5548-5776.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Sword of Truth and Justice's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris and Sword of Truth and Justice trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Truth and Justice trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, then putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 6.

49-2034-4871-6000-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sapphire Medallion.
Repeat.

2079-2366-4974-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2079-2366-4974-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

934-3767-3918-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least X creatures that share a creature type.
934-3767-3918-7013.description:
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3497-6869-6884.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-6869-6884.description:
Cast Aang, Airbending Master by paying {2}{W}
When Aang, Airbending Master enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, the Last Airbender
Cast Aang, the Last Airbender from exile by paying {0}.
When Aang, the Last Airbender enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, Airbending Master.
Cast Aang, Airbending Master from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.
3497-6869-6884.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you've gained more than 2 life this turn to a minimum of {W}.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Stormchaser Drake

1525-2031-2406-2660-6913.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-6913.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

339-677-2034-3499.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

413-527-1636-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
413-527-1636-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Intruder Alarm and Blasting Station trigger, untapping all creatures and Blasting Station.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{U} plus an additional {X} equal to Sin's power minus 3.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Selvala.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

2382-5659-6798--33.notablePrerequisites: One Lhurgoyf must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mimic Vat.
2382-5659-6798--33.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a nontoken Lhurgoyf.
When the Lhurgoyf dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard and returning the Lhurgoyf that was exiled to your graveyard.
Disa's first ability triggers, putting the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2316-5231-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-5231-6753.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Rite of Passage

292-736-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage and Copy Enchantment trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.

1737-4242-4853-5147.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, Su-Chi and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1283-3767-3918-4875.description:
Activate Trazyn using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1621-1987-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
1621-1987-4605.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

3470-4806-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3470-4806-5702.description:
Activate Blinkmoth Nexus's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Blinkmoth Nexus's second ability by paying {1}, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to Blinkmoth Nexus.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Blinkmoth Nexus.
When the Blinkmoth Nexus token enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Blinkmoth Nexus token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 6.

413-2867-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

539-2713-4687.notablePrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
539-2713-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

864-877-2281-5256.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness dies, Saffi triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 2, causing target player to mill cards equal to Eternal Witness's power.
Cast Saffi by paying {0} due to Morophon.
Repeat.

1030-2034-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Othelm.
Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
1030-2034-2178.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Othelm, untapping Othelm.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning the nontoken creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3075-3368-4276.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three experience counters.
Lands you control are able to tap and produce at least {1}{R}{R}.
3075-3368-4276.description:
Cast Turnabout by paying {U}{U}.
Mizzix triggers, causing you to get an experience counter.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate for its buyback cost by paying {R}{R}, copying Turnabout and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Turnabout copy, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
